source_facts: Definition of real structure: antiholomorphic map rho: CP1 -> CP1 with rho squared identity.
rho_tw homogeneous coordinates [-conj(z2),conj(z1)], projective square identity, vector square minus identity.
No projective fixed point satisfies rho_tw(point)=point.
These are source-local map assertions, not new generic module semantics.

findings.observation: W097 directly declares a CP1 -> CP1 real-structure map; G1 0.23 still omits map declaration/totality/functionhood as a separate semantic occurrence. G7 substitutes relation R carrying only realized application incidences and then closes O06/O04.
findings.reason: Universal equation rho_tw^2=id is a total map assertion over source projective points. A relation with no two-step paths satisfies universal two-step-return implication vacuously, but cannot reconstruct source map application on every point. Positive partial/multivalued countermodels of schema 221101 exhibit the gap.
findings.effect: The G7 campaign-local W097 O06/O04 CLOSED_WITH_CAMPAIGN_LOCAL_PROVISIONAL_AUTHORITY disposition is unsupported by exact source reconstruction. Reopen both as incomplete after G0; G4/G5 consumption of their closure is historical/stale. Do not revoke generic schema 221101 G6 qualification, whose scope explicitly permits partial relations.
findings.no_false_math_claim: These finite structures falsify semantic entailment of source map obligations by the generic schema, not Woit's actual twistor map or the qualified generic relation schema.
